banner.bodyWithLabel: {{resource}} is open in another tab of this browser. Saving here will overwrite changes made there.
banner.switchHint: Or switch to your other tab to keep editing there.

list.likelyCause: Either no rules are configured yet, or every rule has evaluated cleanly in the selected window.
list.meaning: No alerts have fired — this is the expected steady state.

efficiency.likelyCause: Most often the selected range contains no completed drives — widen it before assuming data is missing.
efficiency.meaning: No efficiency figures can be computed for the selected period.

list.likelyCause: This list is empty by default — automations are opt-in and are never created for you.
list.meaning: No automations are configured, so nothing is being evaluated.

degradation.likelyCause: Most often the vehicle was linked recently, so the observation window is still too short to be meaningful.
degradation.meaning: There is not enough history yet to estimate battery degradation.

list.likelyCause: Most often the vehicle has not charged since it was linked, or it charged while asleep and unreachable.
list.meaning: No charging sessions have been recorded for this vehicle yet.

list.likelyCause: Most often the vehicle has not driven since it was linked, or the selected date range ends before the first recorded drive.
list.meaning: No completed drives have been recorded for this vehicle yet.

live.likelyCause: Most often the vehicle is asleep — Tesla stops streaming while a car sleeps, and waking it costs range.
live.meaning: No live signals are arriving for this vehicle right now.

list.likelyCause: Either setup has not been completed, or the stored Tesla authorisation was revoked and needs renewing.
list.meaning: No vehicles are linked, so nothing is being collected anywhere in the app.

errorBoundary.body: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
errorBoundary.chunkBody: A new version was deployed. Click Reload to load the latest assets.
errorBoundary.connectionBody: Unable to reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errorBoundary.retriesExceeded: Multiple retries failed. Try refreshing the page or checking system status.

operationalMode.writeBlocked: Return to live mode before making operational changes.

context.title: What is sent with your report

form.description: What were you doing, and what did you expect?
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Steps you took, what you saw, and what you expected to see instead.
form.includeDiagnostics: Attach a redacted technical summary ({{count}} recent errors)
form.includeDiagnosticsHint: Versions, browser capability, service health, error messages and trace IDs. Never VINs, locations, tokens, e-mail addresses or raw logs.
form.title: What went wrong?
form.titlePlaceholder: Short summary (e.g. "Charging costs show as blank")

problemReport.intro: Describe what happened in your own words. We attach a redacted technical summary only if you allow it.
problemReport.submitError: Could not send the report. Please try again.
problemReport.title: Report a problem

lowBandwidth.effectsOff: When active: polling slows down, animations stop, charts render fewer points, heavy basemaps fall back to light tiles, and the service worker stops caching new images and map tiles.
lowBandwidth.effectsOn: While active: background polling slows to a quarter of its normal rate, entrance animations are disabled, charts render at most {{points}} points, satellite/terrain basemaps fall back to the lightest raster tiles, and the service worker stops storing new images and map tiles.
lowBandwidth.heading: Low-bandwidth mode
lowBandwidth.label: Data usage on this device
lowBandwidth.statusNetwork: Active — your browser or network reported Data Saver / a 2G-class connection.
lowBandwidth.statusOff: Not active — the app is using full quality.
lowBandwidth.statusUser: Active — enabled manually on this device.

backup.active: Watching until {{until}} unless grid service returns or you stop the watch.
backup.confirmCircuit: I verified this charger is on the connected site’s backed-up circuit
backup.confirmOutage: I confirmed a current utility outage, not intentional off-grid mode
backup.connect: Connect the backed-up Tesla Energy site under Solar charging opportunities first. Solar checks may remain off.
backup.ended: This watch ended. Remove it before starting a new watch.
backup.evidence: Two consistent readings after your outage confirmation show {{vehicle}} of vehicle charging and at least {{minimum}} coming from the home battery. This is a conservative estimate from the site meters, not a backup runtime forecast.
backup.expiredLink: This private watch is no longer available.
backup.noDevice: Verify a browser and enable charging notifications in Personal delivery before starting.
backup.privacy: Off by default. After you confirm a current utility outage, TeslaSync checks read-only Tesla Energy meters for one hour and can notify one verified browser. The vehicle location stays here. No vehicle or home settings are changed.
backup.reviewTitle: Vehicle charging is drawing from household backup
backup.signIn: Sign in to use a private backup charging watch.
backup.start: Watch this outage for one hour
backup.title: Charging on household backup
backup.unavailable: Setup requires read-only Tesla Energy, shared live signals, and personal browser notifications.
backup.waiting: No current evidence of a material draw from backup.

smartCharging.changeFailed: The change was not saved. Refresh and try again.
smartCharging.chooseVehicle: Choose the vehicle whose charging plans you want to manage.
smartCharging.compareSiteRates: Compare costs using verified place prices
smartCharging.compareSiteRatesConsent: Enable only after checking that this place’s dated price windows and currency apply to your future charging. Historical prices are not recurring tariffs.
smartCharging.conflictWindowsHint: Record an appointment or install window you confirmed. Leave both times blank to remove a window. Update it here if plans change; TeslaSync does not update or verify the source schedule.
smartCharging.deleteDescription: This removes the plan and its pending decision. It does not delete driving or charging records.

delivery.browserUnavailable: Personal browser delivery needs a supported browser and a secure, same-origin connection.
delivery.changeFailed: The delivery preference was not saved. Refresh and retry.
delivery.clearFailed: The browser subscription could not be removed. Retry from this browser.
delivery.connectFailed: Could not confirm this browser. Check notification permission and server configuration, then retry.
delivery.disconnectDescription: Pending personal deliveries are invalidated. Plans and existing alert channels are unchanged.
delivery.disconnectFailed: The device could not be fully disconnected. Refresh and retry; remove any remaining browser subscription if needed.
delivery.empty: No personal devices are connected. Charging push is off by default.
delivery.owned: This browser is linked to another account. Sign in as its owner to disconnect it first.
delivery.pending: Waiting for this browser to confirm its subscription.
delivery.privacy: Your browser’s push service receives an encrypted, short-lived token, not trip details. TeslaSync checks the same account and current consent before showing a generic notification.
delivery.pushBody: Open TeslaSync to review a charging decision.
delivery.serverUnavailable: Personal delivery needs VAPID credentials and the same encryption key on the API and notification worker. Existing alert channels are separate.
delivery.shared: Without sign-in, anyone with access to TeslaSync can manage these delivery devices.
delivery.title: Personal browser notifications
delivery.verifyBody: This browser is ready for personal notifications.

smartCharging.description: Plans are off until you enable them. The notification worker checks fresh shared signals for unplugged or slow charging without waking the car. Advice appears in Action Center; personal browser notifications require separate device consent.
smartCharging.destinationChargeAssumption: The return estimate assumes the planned {{charge}}% destination charge; it is not confirmed or guaranteed.
smartCharging.destinationChargeHint: Optional. This is a plan, not a confirmed or guaranteed charge. Leave blank to assume no destination charging.
smartCharging.destinationChargePlan: Planned destination charge: {{charge}}% added; not confirmed.
smartCharging.destinationEstimate: With {{start}}% at departure, estimated charge at the destination is {{low}}-{{high}}% against a {{reserve}}% reserve.
smartCharging.destinationUncertain: The higher outbound estimate may leave the destination unreachable.
smartCharging.destinationUnreachable: With {{start}}% at departure, even the lower outbound estimate exceeds the available charge. Review a stop before the destination.
smartCharging.earlierReminderChanged: This preview expired or the plan changed. Close it and refresh the estimate.
smartCharging.earlierReminderScope: Only this plan’s check time will change. A push still needs a verified charging device and a timely issue. Nothing changes on the vehicle.
smartCharging.earlyStopWatchHint: Check recent charging signals for this plan. A private push requires verified personal charging delivery. This does not start charging or diagnose a fault.
smartCharging.enablePlan: Enable readiness checks for this plan
smartCharging.formPrivacy: Your estimate and chosen charging place stay on this server. Enabling this plan does not start charging or send a vehicle command.
smartCharging.identityMissingDescription: Your authentication provider did not supply a verified identity.
smartCharging.invalidConflictWindow: Enter both times in order and within seven days of departure, or leave both blank. Skipped daylight-saving times are not valid.
smartCharging.invalidPlan: Choose an active charging place, valid percentages and times at least 30 minutes apart. Departure must be within the next year. Skipped daylight-saving times are not valid.
smartCharging.latestStartEmpty: Estimates appear for enabled, unsnoozed plans when fresh battery and charging signals are available.
smartCharging.latestStartEstimate: Using the nominal pack-energy estimate and measured {{power}} at the selected place, start by {{earliest}} for your higher trip-use value or {{latest}} for your lower value (observed {{observed}}). Estimates include a 25% time buffer; actual charging power can change.
smartCharging.latestStartExpired: This estimate expired because its live evidence is no longer fresh. Refresh to check again.
smartCharging.latestStartLegsUnachievable: The higher leg estimates and reserve cannot be met by charging only at the selected place. Review a stop or planned destination charging.
smartCharging.latestStartNotCharging: No positive charging power is currently measured. A connected plug alone is not enough to estimate a safe start.
smartCharging.latestStartOutsideSite: The vehicle is not confirmed at the selected charging place, so power measured elsewhere cannot be used.
smartCharging.latestStartOverdue: At the measured {{power}}, the estimated start for your higher trip-use value has passed. Check the vehicle; no schedule was changed.
smartCharging.latestStartPaused: Latest-start refresh is paused while offline. Reconnect to check live charging power.
smartCharging.latestStartPlanChanged: This plan changed. Refresh its estimate before relying on it.
smartCharging.latestStartSufficient: Your current battery meets the trip-use and reserve estimate you entered; no charge is estimated as necessary.
smartCharging.latestStartSufficientWithDestination: No extra charge is estimated before departure if the planned destination charging happens. Check that the plan is still feasible.
smartCharging.latestStartUnachievable: The upper trip-use estimate plus your reserve exceeds 100% battery, so this trip target cannot be reached by charging alone.
smartCharging.latestStartUnavailable: A current estimate is unavailable. Fresh battery and pack-capacity data are required.
smartCharging.latestStartUnknownLocation: A fresh parked location is required to confirm charging power at the selected place.
smartCharging.legEstimateHint: Enter a low and high battery-use estimate for each leg. These are your estimates, not measured route predictions.
smartCharging.noDestinationChargeAssumption: The return estimate assumes no destination charging.
smartCharging.noPlaces: Add or review a charging place in Locations before creating a plan.
smartCharging.noPlans: No trip plan is saved. Add one when you want readiness checks.
smartCharging.overlapPush: Send a private push for a departure conflict
smartCharging.overlapPushHint: Requires verified personal charging push. If both windows overlap departure, the card shows the service appointment first.
smartCharging.placeUnavailable: The selected charging place is unavailable or needs review.

publicFee.action: Charging finished and the car was still connected
publicFee.allowPush: Send fee reminders to this verified browser
publicFee.confirmPlace: I verified this location is a public charging site
publicFee.confirmTerms: I reviewed fixed terms that apply after completion while connected, with no occupancy or other conditions
publicFee.invalid: Enter a public HTTPS source, exact fee and currency, 2–60 minutes of grace, and 1–30 days of validity. Both reviews are required.
publicFee.needsReview: Review the terms again. The previous review expired or the charging place changed.
publicFee.noDecision: There is no current fee reminder for this session. It may have expired or the evidence may have changed.
publicFee.observed: Connection evidence observed at {{when}}. This is not a statement that a fee was charged.
publicFee.off: No active public-site fee review is saved for this vehicle.
publicFee.privacy: Off by default. Review fixed, current terms for one public charging place. TeslaSync does not check station occupancy, contact the operator, or operate the car. An optional push carries only a short-lived token.
publicFee.pushBody: Charging has finished. Open TeslaSync for the reviewed fee terms and timing.
publicFee.pushTitle: A charging fee may start soon
publicFee.timing: The reviewed fee is {{rate}} per minute after the grace period. It could start as early as {{earliest}}. Check the station and move the car if it is safe.
publicFee.title: Public charging fee reminders
publicFee.verifyDevice: Confirm this browser in Personal browser notifications before enabling push. You can still save the review without push.

smartCharging.rateComparisonEstimate: For the higher trip-use estimate ({{energy}}), charging now is about {{now}}; starting at {{start}} is about {{later}}, saving {{saving}} ({{currency}}).
smartCharging.rateComparisonLimits: Based on the place’s dated prices and the current measured power, with a 25% time buffer. Power can change; taxes, fixed fees and charging losses are excluded. Savings must be at least 10% and one currency unit. No schedule is changed.
smartCharging.requirements: Checks require a running notification worker, shared live signals, and a reviewed place marked as a charging location. Stale or missing evidence produces no advice.
smartCharging.returnEstimate: If the destination is reached, the estimated return charge is {{low}}-{{high}}%.
smartCharging.returnUncertain: The higher return-use estimate may require another charge.
smartCharging.returnUnreachable: The return cannot be completed without an additional charge under these estimates.
smartCharging.reviewStop: Review a charging stop in Trip Planner
smartCharging.schedulePowerCeilingHint: Enter a known upper limit for this charging place. Leave blank if you do not know it. This does not change charging power.
smartCharging.scheduledStartHint: Enter the date and time you expect charging to start, between “Check from” and one day after departure. This does not set a vehicle schedule.

sharedCharger.acceptReminder: Show me one private in-app reminder if a swap is due
sharedCharger.activeConflict: This reviewed charger already has an active plan. Use that plan or wait for it to end.
sharedCharger.advisory: Coordinate two vehicles at one reviewed charger. This is advice only: it never starts, stops, or reschedules charging.
sharedCharger.changeFailed: The change was not saved. Refresh the plans and check your sign-in, permissions, and the current revision.
sharedCharger.choicesRequired: Authorizing a plan requires current data for two active vehicles and a reviewed place marked as a charging location.
sharedCharger.confirm: Confirm my vehicle for this revision
sharedCharger.confirmed: You confirmed this vehicle for the current plan revision.
sharedCharger.invalidAuthorization: Choose a reviewed place, two different vehicles, exact sign-in subjects, and a future expiry.
sharedCharger.invalidConfirmation: Enter a valid future departure after availability, a nonnegative energy estimate, positive charging power, and current plug occupancy.
sharedCharger.manualSwap: Before the first slot, verify that the first vehicle can use the charger and agree on any needed disconnect. Coordinate the manual handoff at {{time}}, allowing at least 10 minutes to unplug and reconnect.
sharedCharger.needsConfirmation: Confirm your vehicle to take part. An order appears only after both vehicles confirm and a handoff is needed and feasible.
sharedCharger.noInvitations: No active invitations on this page for your signed-in account.
sharedCharger.noOrder: No actionable order is available. The other vehicle may not have confirmed, no safe handoff may be needed or feasible, or the advice may have expired.
sharedCharger.noOwned: No active plans you authorized on this page.
sharedCharger.operatorEvidence: Choose the reviewed place that represents this one shared charger and enter each vehicle’s exact verified sign-in subject. Each participant must confirm separately, even if both vehicles use the same sign-in.
sharedCharger.participantEvidence: Confirm only your vehicle’s availability, departure, estimated energy need, conservative charging power, and current connection to this charger. Only the derived order and slot times will be shared.
sharedCharger.reminderMessage: The handoff for {{vehicle}} was planned for {{swap}}. If both participants are ready, coordinate it manually. This reminder expires at {{expires}}.
sharedCharger.reviseEvidence: A new revision clears both confirmations. Enter both permissions again; prior participants and their inputs are not shown here.
sharedCharger.revokeImpact: This ends the plan for both participants, removes the shared advice, and cancels any future swap reminder. It does not change either vehicle.
sharedCharger.signInRequired: A verified browser sign-in is required for private charger planning.
sharedCharger.swapPublished: This plan cannot be revised because its one swap reminder was already published.
sharedCharger.title: Share one charger
sharedCharger.why: Why this order? Both participants confirmed this revision. The estimate uses their declared charging windows, energy, power, and plug occupancy—not live charging measurements.
sharedCharger.zoneHint: Times use {{zone}}. Repeated daylight-saving times use the first occurrence; skipped times must be changed.

sharedTrip.cancelDescription: Cancel this shared departure and all invitations? Participants will lose access to the comparison.
sharedTrip.changeFailed: The shared trip change was not saved. Refresh and try again.
sharedTrip.confirmationExpired: Your confirmation has expired. Confirm again to participate.
sharedTrip.confirmationPrivacy: Use conservative estimates for the entire trip. Other confirmed participants only see eligible options and battery estimates, not your schedule or service details. Your confirmation expires within 24 hours or at departure, whichever comes first.
sharedTrip.consentRequired: A current confirmation is required to view this comparison.
sharedTrip.description: Compare vehicles for one explicitly shared departure. Only verified participants who confirm their invitation can view the comparison.
sharedTrip.invalidConfirmation: Enter a battery use range from 0 to 100 with the minimum first, a reserve, and both clearance answers.
sharedTrip.invalidPlan: Enter a future departure, distinct active vehicles, and exact sign-in identities without extra spaces.
sharedTrip.maintenance: Is the vehicle clear of overdue maintenance for this departure?
sharedTrip.maintenanceNotClear: No, or I am not sure
sharedTrip.needVehicles: At least two active vehicles are needed to create or revise a shared trip.
sharedTrip.nextStep: Review the estimated return ranges and check the chosen vehicle again before departure. These estimates are not a guarantee or a reservation.
sharedTrip.noComparison: A comparison needs two eligible, confirmed vehicles with current battery evidence. Refresh to check again.
sharedTrip.noInvitations: No upcoming shared departures are awaiting or using your confirmation.
sharedTrip.noOwned: You have no upcoming shared trips.
sharedTrip.nominate: Nominate an exact browser sign-in identity for each vehicle. An invitation does not let you confirm for someone else.
sharedTrip.optionEvidence: Battery observed at {{observed}}; option expires at {{expires}}.
sharedTrip.replaceRoster: Revising replaces every invitation. Enter the complete roster again; all participants must reconfirm.
sharedTrip.schedule: Is the vehicle available for the shared departure?
sharedTrip.scheduleNotClear: No, or I am not sure
sharedTrip.signInRequired: Shared trip planning requires a verified browser sign-in.
sharedTrip.title: Shared trip planning
sharedTrip.why: Why this order? Vehicles with the largest estimated buffer above their reserve in the worst case appear first. Availability and maintenance are participant-confirmed.
sharedTrip.withdrawDescription: Remove your vehicle and this invitation from the shared trip? You will need a new invitation to participate with this vehicle again.

sitePerformance.actionTitle: Charging has been slower at this place
sitePerformance.basis: Timestamped charging meter readings and similar charge levels and connector type
sitePerformance.empty: No repeated slowdown is supported by comparable sessions for this place.
sitePerformance.limitation: Elapsed rates can include pauses. Review the current limit, schedule and site conditions; this is not a charger diagnosis.
sitePerformance.privacy: Off by default. Allow TeslaSync to compare this vehicle’s completed sessions at one reviewed charging place. Nothing is sent outside TeslaSync and this does not enable push.
sitePerformance.rationale: Two recent sessions delivered materially less energy per elapsed hour than comparable sessions for the same vehicle and location.
sitePerformance.summary: {{recentCount}} recent sessions averaged {{recent}} at {{place}}; the median across {{baselineCount}} comparable sessions was {{baseline}}.
sitePerformance.title: Charging at a saved place

solar.basis: Timestamped Tesla Energy readings and fresh shared vehicle signals
solar.disable: Turn off solar checks for this vehicle
solar.disconnect: Disconnect Tesla Energy and remove all solar plans
solar.enable: Enable solar checks for this vehicle
solar.evidence: At least {{export}} was exported across {{samples}} readings since {{start}}. Your home battery was at {{backup}}% with a {{reserve}}% reserve. The plugged-in vehicle was at {{battery}}%, below its {{target}}% limit.
solar.linkFailed: Tesla Energy was not connected. Check the site ID and Tesla permissions, then try again.
solar.noDecision: No current opportunity. Checks require a locally observed parked, plugged-in vehicle below its limit, sustained export, and backup above the reserve.
solar.off: Solar checks are off for this vehicle.
solar.opportunity: There may be surplus solar available to charge
solar.privacy: Off by default. Allow read-only Tesla Energy access for one site, then choose a home charger for this vehicle. No push, vehicle wake, charging change, or change to your backup reserve.
solar.rationale: Repeated export readings show the home battery remains above its configured reserve.
solar.siteHelp: Use the energy_site_id of your Solar and Powerwall installation from the Tesla Fleet API Products endpoint. The site ID is sent to Tesla to verify access and read its status.
solar.timing: Evidence as of {{observed}}; advice expires at {{expires}}. Export can change. If you have not already started, review charging on the car while parked.
solar.title: Solar charging opportunities
solar.unavailable: Setup requires Tesla Fleet API credentials, an HTTPS callback registered with Tesla, encryption, and shared live signals.

stopComparison.changed: The plan or a place changed. Review the current details before allowing a new check.
stopComparison.compatible: I verified that these stops have a connector this vehicle can use.
stopComparison.consent: Allow HERE Routing to receive the coordinates of the departure, destination and reviewed stops only when I request a comparison.
stopComparison.failure: Comparison or setup could not be completed. Review the plan, places and routing connection before trying again.
stopComparison.identity: Stop comparisons are private and require a verified sign-in.
stopComparison.invalid: Check the plan and locations, charge percentages above your reserve, and the wait format. Use a different place for each stop and for the destination.
stopComparison.noComparison: No current comparison. The direct route may meet your reserve, or fewer than two reachable stops have enough evidence: eight similar wait days and three compatible measured charging sessions for the needed charge range.
stopComparison.off: Off. Review the outbound trip and allow HERE Routing before comparing anything. No push or vehicle operation is available here.
stopComparison.origin: The charging place on this plan is the departure point: {{place}}.
stopComparison.paused: Resume a future trip plan before requesting a comparison.
stopComparison.removeDescription: This revokes HERE Routing access for this plan and removes its queue observations and comparison. It does not delete driving or charging records.
stopComparison.reserve: Estimated stop arrival at {{when}} with {{stopCharge}}%. The comparison budgets enough charging to reach your destination at the {{destinationReserve}}% reserve.
stopComparison.samples: Evidence: {{waits}} recorded wait days and {{charges}} comparable measured charging sessions at this place.
stopComparison.setup: Review the outbound trip and charging stops
stopComparison.times: Extra road distance: {{distance}}. Extra driving: {{drive}} min. Historical wait: {{wait}} min. Estimated charge: {{charge}} min.
stopComparison.title: Compare reviewed charging stops
stopComparison.unavailable: Ask your operator to configure licensed HERE Routing. No new checks can run while it is disconnected.
stopComparison.waitHint: Enter one arrival timestamp and actual wait in minutes per line, separated by a comma. Include the UTC offset or Z. Example: 2026-03-10T08:45:00-07:00,7. Use 0 only for an observed absence of a queue.
stopComparison.why: Ranked by extra road time, recorded median wait and estimated charge time. Arrival uses your higher consumption and entered battery capacity, with a charging time buffer. These estimates do not verify traffic, open stalls or the return trip.

smartCharging.timeZoneHint: Times use {{zone}}. A repeated daylight-saving time uses its first occurrence; skipped times must be changed.
smartCharging.title: Charging readiness

tripMaintenance.cardBasis: Recorded odometer: {{current}} on {{observed}}. You entered a service at {{serviced}} on {{serviceDate}}, an interval of {{interval}}, and a trip estimate of {{tripLow}} to {{tripHigh}}.
tripMaintenance.cardLimitation: This compares your trip estimate with the interval you recorded. It does not assess vehicle condition or book service.
tripMaintenance.cardSummary: {{service}} is due at {{due}}. The trip on {{departure}} would put the estimated odometer between {{low}} and {{high}}.
tripMaintenance.consent: Compare this trip with the recorded service interval and this vehicle’s recent odometer readings. Nothing is sent outside TeslaSync.
tripMaintenance.failure: Could not change the check. Refresh and verify that the vehicle and trip still match.
tripMaintenance.invalid: Enter a completed service, a valid odometer and interval, and positive trip distances in increasing order.
tripMaintenance.off: Off. Record a completed service, its documented interval, and this plan’s estimated total distance.
tripMaintenance.offline: Reconnect to review the saved interval.
tripMaintenance.paused: Checks are paused for this plan or the departure time has passed.
tripMaintenance.removeMessage: The interval and trip-distance assumptions entered here will be removed. Your charging plan and drives are not affected.
tripMaintenance.stale: The plan changed. Review the interval and trip distance again before another check.
tripMaintenance.title: Maintenance before this trip
tripMaintenance.waiting: No current interval crossing. It takes a recent odometer reading and a departure within 14 days with time to act.

smartCharging.tripProjectionLimitation: These are estimates, not measurements. A 0% bound may mean a leg cannot be completed.

tripReview.addJourney: Create a planned journey for this vehicle first
tripReview.adjustment: Planning allowance: {{stop}} min more stopped time and {{arrival}} percentage points more arrival-charge buffer.
tripReview.arrived: Arrived {{when}} with {{observed}}% charge; the saved plan expected {{planned}}%.
tripReview.consent: Review the recorded drives and charging for this linked journey only. No data will be sent to a provider.
tripReview.expires: This review uses the matched completed journey and expires {{when}}.
tripReview.failure: Could not change the review. Refresh and verify that the plan, locations and journey still match.
tripReview.invalid: Choose a planned journey and distinct reviewed places. Enter a charge from 0 to 100% and, if stopping, a positive stop time up to six hours.
tripReview.noMatch: No current comparison. The journey is not complete, evidence is missing or does not match the baseline, or the review expired.
tripReview.off: Off. Save a private baseline before departure to compare it with one confirmed completed journey.
tripReview.origin: This plan starts at {{place}}. Only the planned journey you select will be reviewed.
tripReview.removeMessage: The baseline and any saved adjustment will be removed. Your trips, drives and charging records are not affected.
tripReview.saveAdjustment: Save adjustment for a similar trip
tripReview.savedAdjustment: Saved for the next similar trip.
tripReview.setup: Save the outbound baseline before the journey starts
tripReview.similar: A previous trip to the same places has a saved adjustment. You can use it when updating this plan; nothing has changed automatically.
tripReview.stale: The plan or reviewed places changed. This baseline will no longer be compared.
tripReview.stopActual: Planned stop: {{planned}} min. Recorded stop: {{observed}} min, including {{charge}} min in a charging session. The rest is not a measured wait.
tripReview.title: Review planned vs. actual trip
tripReview.waiting: Baseline saved. Start and complete the linked journey in Trips, then return to review the recorded results.

smartCharging.vehicleUnavailable: That vehicle is unavailable. Select a vehicle explicitly; no other vehicle was selected.

delivery.help: Commute push starts off and only applies to routines with approved traffic checks. Enable it from the browser that should receive it. This replaces the previous commute recipient without changing charging notifications.
delivery.pushBody: Open TeslaSync to review a route comparison.
delivery.unavailable: Commute push requires configured HERE traffic checks and shared live signals.

account.success: Account export queued — track progress in the floating widget

bulkDelete.partial: {{deleted}} geofences deleted; some deletions did not complete
